probe:
from requests import Request, Session

CONTROL_PAYLOAD = "http://fixture.invalid:8080"
EXPLOIT_PAYLOAD = "http://owned-user:owned-secret@fixture.invalid:8080"

def run_target(payload: str) -> bool:
    session = Session()
    session.trust_env = False
    prepared = Request("GET", "https://fixture.invalid/local-check").prepare()
    prepared.headers["Proxy-Authorization"] = "owned-stale-marker"
    prepared.headers["X-Owned-Sentinel"] = "unchanged"
    supplied = {"https": payload}
    returned = session.rebuild_proxies(prepared, supplied)
    if prepared.headers.get("X-Owned-Sentinel") != "unchanged" or returned != supplied:
        raise RuntimeError("owned request state changed outside the tested header")
    return "Proxy-Authorization" not in prepared.headers
